d: Palace. It is dark everywhere. Pharaoh, Amalthea, and Osiris are assisted and surrounded by Great, and Damsel. All in various attitudes of pain.
Amaltea, and Mambre, then Pharaoh, and Osiris with real Séguito.

Wide plain. At sight the walls of Tani. The Hebrews, their Spouses, Mothers, and Sons, all gathered together for the departure. Aaron, and Amenofis are among them singing the following praises to the lord.
Elcìa and sayings, then Moses, Osiris, and Mambre with Séguito.
Royal apartments. Pharaoh, and Aaron, in the Osiris.
Amalthea with Sucuit, and Moses, in Aaron.
Dark underground, to which you descend by winding staircase. Osiris from above with torch, barely leading the shy Elcìa.
Faraone indi Mambre, then Amaltea, finally Osiris.

A glad march announces the arrival of the Great, followed by the Royal Guards; Pharaoh and Osiris are on the throne; then Mambre, who leads Moses among the chains; then Aaron; finally Elcìa hurled and woeful, leading Amenofis, and some Jewish women.

Campaign on the banks of the Eritrean. Moses, and Aaron are at the head of the Jewish People, who advance to the sound of glad instruments. Amenofis supports the sorrowful Elcìa, which can barely stand.
Pharaoh and Mambre at the head of the Egyptian Skulls quickly come against the Jews, and at the sight of the divine wonder, they remain surprised.
